codeSnippets.title: Quality Gate

projects.title: Multi-Tenant Data Platform for BI Analytics
projects.shortDescription: A multi-tenant pipeline integrating SQL Server, orchestration workflows, Snowflake, dbt, and Metabase dashboards.
projects.fullDescription: Designed a BI analytics platform concept that moves operational data into a governed warehouse layer with validation checkpoints and dashboard-ready marts.
projects.challenge: Operational reporting needed repeatable ingestion, validation, tenant-aware modeling, and dashboard-ready semantic structures.
projects.solution: Modeled source-to-warehouse flows with orchestration, validation checkpoints, dbt transformations, tenant-aware marts, and dashboard delivery.
projects.results: Created a maintainable architecture for BI analytics with clearer ownership, validation, and reporting consistency.
projects.architecture: SQL Server and ERP sources feed orchestrated extraction jobs, Snowflake staging, dbt marts, semantic models, and Metabase dashboards.

projects.title: Quality Control Analytics & Reporting System
projects.shortDescription: Quality-control analytics connecting production, harvest, packing, stock, export readiness and client delivery.
projects.fullDescription: A practical analytics layer for quality, production and export readiness KPIs, designed around traceability, defects, conformity and delivery decisions.
projects.challenge: Quality and operations teams need a single reliable view of rejection, defect, grade and export-readiness signals across batches and destinations.
projects.solution: Designed a data model with batch-level quality facts, validation controls, Power BI measures and operational dashboard pages.
projects.results: Improved clarity around quality issues, readiness gaps and operational risk before shipment decisions.
projects.architecture: ERP, production and quality files feed validation tables, modeled facts and Power BI reports with role-aware views.

projects.title: Paper Questionnaire Automation Pipeline
projects.shortDescription: Automated paper questionnaires into structured datasets using OCR, Python processing, SQL storage, and BI reporting.
projects.fullDescription: A practical pipeline for turning paper-based collection into searchable, validated, analytics-ready datasets.
projects.challenge: Manual transcription slowed analysis and introduced quality risks into downstream reporting.
projects.solution: Combined OCR capture, Python validation, SQL storage, review queues and dashboard-ready exports.
projects.results: Reduced repetitive processing effort and created a clearer audit path from source forms to reporting outputs.
projects.architecture: Scanned forms move through OCR extraction, Python cleaning, validation queues, SQL tables and BI dashboards.

projects.title: Business Intelligence Dashboards for ERP Operations
projects.shortDescription: Dashboards for HR, production, inventory, energy consumption, and executive KPI monitoring using ERP data.
projects.fullDescription: Built a BI portfolio pattern for transforming ERP data into operational dashboards and executive KPI monitoring.
projects.challenge: Teams needed consistent, permission-aware reporting across ERP domains without relying on manual spreadsheet updates.
projects.solution: Modeled KPIs, applied DAX and Power Query transformations, and designed dashboards with row-level security concepts.
projects.results: Improved reporting clarity through reusable models, validation checks, and decision-focused dashboard layouts.
projects.architecture: ERP data flows through SQL Server models, Power Query transformations, DAX measures, and Power BI reporting layers.

projects.title: Finance Planning, Forecasting & Analytics Platform
projects.shortDescription: Budget, actuals and forecast model with variance analysis, reconciliation controls and analytics-ready outputs.
projects.fullDescription: A finance analytics pattern connecting planning inputs, actuals, forecasts, variance explanations and executive-ready reporting outputs.
projects.challenge: Finance views need traceable variance logic, consistent definitions and reusable reporting layers.
projects.solution: Modeled budget, actual and forecast facts, built reconciliation controls, and prepared KPI views for dashboarding.
projects.results: Connected finance inputs to decision-ready variance and forecast views.
projects.architecture: Planning files and operational data feed SQL transformations, finance marts and BI reporting layers.

experiences.description: Built analytical datasets and Power BI dashboards for financial and operational reporting, with SQL optimization, VBA automation and data-quality controls.
Designed a multi-tenant embedded BI platform from SQL Server to Snowflake, dbt and Metabase, with Python pipelines and Prefect orchestration.
Automated agricultural data preparation and BI reporting with Python, SQL Server, validation rules and Power BI dashboards.
Completed applied machine-learning projects covering EDA, preprocessing, model training, evaluation and interpretation.
Built a graduate tracking information system with SQL Server, Visual Basic 6 and Crystal Reports.
